text: Mobile app development is an exciting field that combines creativity and technology. When building an app, developers must consider responsive design so it works well on different screen sizes. They also choose between native and cross-platform approaches. Native apps are built for one platform, like iOS or Android, and often deliver the best performance. Cross-platform apps run on multiple platforms using one codebase, which saves time. After development, apps are usually published on app stores such as Google Play or the App Store. Performance is crucial because users expect fast, smooth experiences. A slow app can quickly lose users, no matter how good its design is.
